utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Vik, I only caught the basics—Leo needs folks with screwdrivers and pliers for about an hour Saturday, but I’m still waiting on the exact start time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Bo—I'll hold off on repeating the time until Tess or another trusted source confirms it, but I can pass along that Leo may need screwdriver and plier help Saturday once the details are set.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Vik—that’s perfect. Just keep it loose for now, and if Tess or Opal pins down the time, send it my way.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye, just so you have the latest: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the porch—are you able to help with sign-ups or tool sorting?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa—that helps a lot. I can help with sign-ups and fit tool sorting around school pickup/drop-off rhythms, and I’ll update Opal so we don’t double-book anyone.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you, Faye—please have Opal mark you for sign-ups first, with tool sorting only in the gaps around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Sam—repair drive is Saturday morning this weekend, and I’m checking who’s free between school drop-off and pickup so I can report back to Faye without muddling it with the garden cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Oren—I heard from Rosa it’s moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’m planning to bring my clipboard and labels then to sort the donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh dear, Sam, now my fridge note is sweating—Tess and Cleo had me on Saturday morning, so I’d better double-check with Faye before you haul those labels over on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, we’re still waiting on Tess’s confirmed start time and repair list, but Dane’s set for the sign-up table first hour and I’m lining up small-appliance helpers once the crew spots are clear.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, thanks Jules—I’d missed that Dane was already set for the first hour. I’ll hold off on giving anyone firmer details until Tess’s time and the repair list are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Noah—once Vik passes me Tess’s confirmed details, I’ll get them to you too so we’re all sharing the same info.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Ira—I'm still confirming the Saturday start time before sharing details, but so far Mina has priorities, Rey is gathering volunteer names, and Cleo is keeping tools and spare parts sorted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mara—that helps. I’ll keep asking around while I’m out and wait for your confirmed Saturday time before pointing anyone to specifics.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira—I appreciate you keeping it general for now, and I’ll circle back as soon as the group confirms the Saturday start time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Leo, the repair drive’s already picking up for Saturday morning—bring any lamps, bikes, or wobbly things you’ve got, and please tell a few neighbors too!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. I’ll tell folks to bring items Saturday at 9 by the tool bins, and I’ll keep asking for screwdrivers, pliers, and hour-long volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo—screwdrivers, pliers, and hour-long volunteers will help a lot. I’ll keep spreading Saturday morning too, and I’ll echo the 9 by the tool bins detail once I hear it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I’m late again—I’m on the sign-up table for the first hour, and Leo said the forms are in the blue folder by the tool bins with the crew list on Sam’s clipboard.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. I’ll check the blue folder quietly and make sure Sam’s clipboard matches who actually shows up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, thanks Uli—if anything doesn’t match, flag me and I’ll update the sign-up table before folks start lining up.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nell, the repair drive’s Saturday morning and already filling up with lamps, bikes, and even a wobbly chair—if you’ve got something that needs mending, bring it by early.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess — I’ve heard Saturday morning too, but I’m still treating it as tentative until Rosa confirms the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Good thinking, Nell—I’ll hold off calling it settled until Rosa confirms the time and place, and I’ll pass the word along as soon as she does.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, have you heard anything confirmed on Rey’s repair list yet, especially roofs, steps, heaters, and who’s actually available?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got the time confirmed for Saturday at 9 by the tool bins, but I haven’t seen Rey’s final list yet—once I do, I’ll check roofs, steps, heaters, and who’s available.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Saturday at 9 by the tool bins is useful; please don’t treat the priorities as final until Rey sends the list, and tell me as soon as you see it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Hana—I’m waiting on Tess for the exact start time and a simple repair list, but for now it’s planned for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli—that helps. I’ll treat Saturday morning as tentative until Tess confirms, and I’ll check with Jules so I’m pointing people to the right crews.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a sensible plan, Hana—once Tess gives me the exact time and list, I’ll pass it along so everyone’s saying the same thing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Cleo, I’ll keep sending the safety repairs Mina named to the top of my notes, and I’m glad you’re keeping Saturday’s lamps, chairs, and bike-chain supplies sorted separately.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Rey—I’ll keep the bins clearly labeled for Saturday morning, and if I spot anything that belongs with Mina’s safety repairs, I’ll send it your way first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Cleo—quiet labels and a quick heads-up are exactly what I need. I’ll keep checking volunteer names one-on-one and route anything safety-related back to Mina first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Kira, I’ve got the repair drive listed for Sunday at the community center, with screwdrivers and pliers needed and volunteer slots around school drop-off and pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sunday at the community center might work, but can you confirm Rey’s actual repair list and who exactly is collecting the screwdrivers and pliers before we spread that?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I’ll hold off on spreading it and check Rey’s repair list plus the exact screwdriver and plier collection point before I update anyone.
